description: This file defines classes for decoding HTTP/2 frames, specifically providing primitives for reading and decoding integer types from byte buffers. It includes classes DecodeBuffer and DecodeBufferSubset for managing buffer reading and subset decoding, with methods for decoding various integer sizes and managing buffer cursors.

classes.name: DecodeBuffer
classes.description: A class providing primitives for decoding various integer types from a byte buffer, intended for stack allocation during HTTP/2 frame parsing.

classes.name: DecodeBufferSubset
classes.description: A class representing a subset of a DecodeBuffer, ensuring safe decoding of a known-sized chunk of data and managing cursor advancement upon destruction.

methods.name: DecodeBuffer::DecodeUInt8
methods.description: Decodes an 8-bit unsigned integer from the buffer.

methods.name: DecodeBuffer::DecodeUInt16
methods.description: Decodes a 16-bit unsigned integer from the buffer.

methods.name: DecodeBuffer::DecodeUInt24
methods.description: Decodes a 24-bit unsigned integer from the buffer.

methods.name: DecodeBuffer::DecodeUInt31
methods.description: Decodes a 31-bit unsigned integer, with the high bit reserved.

methods.name: DecodeBuffer::DecodeUInt32
methods.description: Decodes a 32-bit unsigned integer from the buffer.
